verification.notes: Confirmed via ADAC: Focus Mk2 pre-FL 4473/1840/1454, 475/1525 (ADAC 2005 test PDF says 465 l, others 482 l; kept). Mk2 FL height 1503, wb 2640, 503/1546. Mk3 4556x1823x1505, wb 2650, 490/1516. Mk3 FL length 4560 and 490/1516 confirmed; wheelbase still unresolved (angurten 2640, amS pre-FL 2648, ADAC pre-FL 2650) - left null. Mk4 wb 2700, 608/1653 confirmed. Mk4 ST variant powerPs not corrected because variant combines 2.3 EcoBoost (280 PS per ADAC) and 2.0 EcoBlue (190 PS) - consider splitting. Kuga 1 4443/1842/1677, 410/1405, yearTo 12/12 confirmed by ADAC 06/08-02/10. Kuga 2 pre-FL length 4524; Kuga 2 FL 4524, 456/1653, wb 2690, width ~1.86 m confirmed (AutoScout24 2017 test, ADAC); FL ran to 12/19 per ADAC. No Ford press kits found for 2005-2019 generations. 18 searches used.
